title: Onboard Flow Screens: Model Availability Badges & Pricing Toggle Visuals
creator: Aisha Kumar
description: Create a compact set of onboarding/quickstart visuals for the upcoming catalog release notes. Deliverables: 1) model list card variants that show 'Availability' badges (Hosted / Dedicated / Private) and a subtle sunset badge for deprecated models; 2) a pricing toggle control visual that demonstrates switching between Per-token and Reserved pricing views; 3) a compact modal for first-time users summarizing pricing tiers and availability with tooltips. Visuals must be sized for in-doc screenshots (1200x720) and a small card variant for the Console quickstart (360x240). Include accessible color contrast and two variants for light/dark console themes. Assets should be export-ready (SVG and PNG) and include annotated source frames for docs and release notes.
